data: Microsoft's fiscal 2025 gross profit was about $193.9 billion, on revenue of about $281.7 billion for the year ended June 30, 2025. NVIDIA's fiscal 2025 gross profit was about $97.9 billion, on revenue of about $130.5 billion for the year ended January 26, 2025. Microsoft's gross profit is therefore roughly 2.0 times NVIDIA's, or about 1.98 times. The two companies' fiscal years end about five months apart, and these figures come from my training data, so check them against each company's 10-K before relying on them.
